design_note: Decisive, value-aligned voices whose success hinges on an external, time-bound relocation decision colliding with custody-rooted immobility and a near-term kid timeline—text sounds certain, outcome is situationally conditional.

person_a.name: Aisha Rahman
person_a.summary: COO of a climate-tech startup in Oakland; systems thinker, marathon trainee, and direct communicator who keeps promises.

values.faith: Practicing but progressive Muslim; observes Ramadan, values humility and service; comfortable with an interfaith home if there's mutual respect.
values.family: Wants 1–2 kids in the next 12–24 months; froze 12 eggs at 33 as a backup; close with parents and a younger brother in Fremont; open to being a loving stepmom.
values.career: Career is intense through the next fundraise; plan is to hire a VP of Ops post–Series B to reduce 80-hour weeks; board is pushing for a New York presence and may require HQ relocation.

attraction.stated_type: Grounded men who show up, family-first, emotionally literate, proud of their work without being ego-driven.
attraction.self_described_spark_with_b: Danny is steady under pressure; on week three I took a red-eye to catch his 24-hour off cycle, and he swapped a tour to make my investor dinner. When I spiraled about a board deck, he quietly walked me through priorities—eye contact that felt like a home base.

emotional_profile.maturity: I timebox conflict and ask for repair: after snapping during a crunch week, I sent a 'repair' calendar invite, led with ownership, and changed my calendar so it wouldn’t repeat. I keep small promises (Friday calls happen even if it's 15 minutes).
emotional_profile.attachment_style: Earned-secure with anxious edges; if texts dip, I say 'I’m feeling distant—can we check in tonight?' rather than test. I ended a 2-year situationship when patterns of ambivalence repeated despite a clear plan.
emotional_profile.growth_orientation: Weekly therapy for 3 years; monthly personal retros with action items; replaced two late-work nights with no-meeting evenings; mentor two women founders and solicit 360 feedback from my team quarterly.

person_a.life_stage: 35, renting in Temescal; travels to NYC 3–4 days each month; board vote in ~10 months may move HQ to NYC within 6 months post-vote; will not do long-distance beyond ~12 months without a cohabitation plan; aiming to try for pregnancy within 12–18 months via natural conception or IUI/IVF.
dealbreakers: disrespect toward my faith or family

person_b.name: Daniel "Danny" Morales
person_b.summary: FDNY firefighter/paramedic in Queens; dad to an 8-year-old; service-driven, dry humor, communicates plainly and follows through.

values.faith: Culturally Catholic—Christmas and Easter with my mom; believe in showing up more than preaching; open to an interfaith home and learning partner's traditions.
values.family: Co-parent my 8-year-old son week-on/week-off within a 10-block radius; want one more kid if the partnership is stable; Sundays are for my son and my mom’s caldo—being present is non-negotiable.
values.career: Union lifer with 24-hour shifts and strong seniority; studying for the lieutenant exam in 18 months; NYC-based for the foreseeable future to protect custody and pension.

attraction.stated_type: Women who lead with competence and warmth, can handle an unpredictable schedule, and are blunt but kind.
attraction.self_described_spark_with_a: Aisha runs hot in the best way—competent and caring. Mid-dinner when I got a call, she packed food for my crew without drama. Conversation snaps into place like we’ve worked the same command board.

emotional_profile.maturity: Post-divorce, I repair fast and proactively: if a call runs late, I text ETAs; when I got short from sleep debt, I apologized next day and set a 'no serious talks until I’ve napped' rule.
emotional_profile.attachment_style: Mostly secure; I don’t chase or ghost. I do compartmentalize after gnarly calls and say, 'I need 30 minutes and a shower,' then I come back present.
emotional_profile.growth_orientation: Monthly men’s group since the divorce; completed a co-parenting course; read a parenting chapter weekly with my ex to stay aligned; starting a first-responder therapist next month to widen my tools.

person_b.life_stage: 37, owns a co-op in Astoria two blocks from my son’s school and six from my ex; custody agreement anchors me to NYC for at least 5 years; can travel on child-free weeks only; open to cohabiting after 9–12 months with careful kid introductions; not leaving the metro area.
dealbreakers: expects me to relocate away from my son
